metaDescription: Order custom Bulwark lanyards in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for ID badges and security. Get your quote today.
introHtml: Bulwark lanyards are built for durability and security, making them a smart choice for workplaces that demand tough, reliable ID badge holders. Whether you are equipping a manufacturing floor or a field service team, these lanyards hold up under daily wear. Choose from breakaway or standard styles, and add your logo with screen printing or dye sublimation for a clean, professional look that lasts.
